{
  "candidate_rtl": "module pw_alu_fast_add #(
    parameter WIDTH = 64
)(
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] a, b,
    input wire cin,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0] sum
);
    localparam BLOCKS = (WIDTH+3)/4;
    localparam PAD_WIDTH = 4*BLOCKS;
    localparam LEVELS = $clog2(BLOCKS);
    wire [PAD_WIDTH-1:0] p, g;
    wire [BLOCKS-1:0] pp [0:LEVELS];
    wire [BLOCKS-1:0] gg [0:LEVELS];
    wire [BLOCKS-1:0] bc;
    genvar i, k, l;
    generate
        for (i=0; i<PAD_WIDTH; i=i+1) begin: bit_terms
            if (i<WIDTH) begin: real_bit
                assign p[i] = a[i] ^ b[i];
                assign g[i] = a[i] & b[i];
            end else begin: padding
                assign p[i] = 1'b0;
                assign g[i] = 1'b0;
            end
        end
        for (k=0; k<BLOCKS; k=k+1) begin: groups
            assign pp[0][k] = p[4*k+3] & p[4*k+2] & p[4*k+1] & p[4*k];
            assign gg[0][k] = g[4*k+3]
                | (p[4*k+3] & g[4*k+2])
                | (p[4*k+3] & p[4*k+2] & g[4*k+1])
                | (p[4*k+3] & p[4*k+2] & p[4*k+1] & g[4*k]);
        end
        for (l=0; l<LEVELS; l=l+1) begin: prefix_levels
            for (k=0; k<BLOCKS; k=k+1) begin: prefix_nodes
                if (k >= (1<<l)) begin: combine
                    assign pp[l+1][k] = pp[l][k] & pp[l][k-(1<<l)];
                    assign gg[l+1][k] = gg[l][k]
                        | (pp[l][k] & gg[l][k-(1<<l)]);
                end else begin: pass
                    assign pp[l+1][k] = pp[l][k];
                    assign gg[l+1][k] = gg[l][k];
                end
            end
        end
        for (k=0; k<BLOCKS; k=k+1) begin: block_carries
            if (k==0) begin: first
                assign bc[k] = cin;
            end else begin: later
                assign bc[k] = gg[LEVELS][k-1] | (pp[LEVELS][k-1] & cin);
            end
        end
        for (i=0; i<WIDTH; i=i+1) begin: sum_bits
            wire c;
            if ((i%4)==0) begin: c0
                assign c = bc[i/4];
            end else if ((i%4)==1) begin: c1
                assign c = g[i-1] | (p[i-1] & bc[i/4]);
            end else if ((i%4)==2) begin: c2
                assign c = g[i-1] | (p[i-1] & g[i-2])
                    | (p[i-1] & p[i-2] & bc[i/4]);
            end else begin: c3
                assign c = g[i-1] | (p[i-1] & g[i-2])
                    | (p[i-1] & p[i-2] & g[i-3])
                    | (p[i-1] & p[i-2] & p[i-3] & bc[i/4]);
            end
            assign sum[i] = p[i] ^ c;
        end
    endgenerate
endmodule

module pw_alu #(
    parameter WIDTH = 64
)(
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] a, b,
    input wire [2:0] Oper,
    output reg [WIDTH-1:0] sum
);
    wire add_sel = (Oper == 3'b000);
    wire ab_sel = (Oper == 3'b001);
    wire ba_sel = (Oper == 3'b010);
    wire or_sel = (Oper == 3'b011);
    wire and_sel = (Oper == 3'b100);
    wire xor_sel = (Oper == 3'b101);
    wire xnor_sel = (Oper == 3'b110);
    wire arith_sel = add_sel | ab_sel | ba_sel;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] aa = a ^ {WIDTH{ba_sel}};
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] bb = b ^ {WIDTH{ab_sel}};
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] arithmetic_sum;
    pw_alu_fast_add #(.WIDTH(WIDTH)) arithmetic (
        .a(aa), .b(bb), .cin(ab_sel | ba_sel), .sum(arithmetic_sum)
    );
    always @* begin
        sum = (arithmetic_sum & {WIDTH{arith_sel}})
            | ((a | b) & {WIDTH{or_sel}})
            | ((a & b) & {WIDTH{and_sel}})
            | ((a ^ b) & {WIDTH{xor_sel}})
            | ((a ~^ b) & {WIDTH{xnor_sel}});
    end
endmodule

module pw_pipeline_alu #(
    parameter WIDTH = 32,
    parameter STAGES = 2
)(
    input wire clk, rst,
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] a, b,
    input wire [2:0] Oper,
    input wire in_valid,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0] result,
    output wire out_valid
);
    reg [WIDTH-1:0] operand_a, operand_b;
    reg [2:0] opcode;
    reg input_valid;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] alu_result;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] stage_data [0:STAGES-2];
    wire stage_valid [0:STAGES-2];

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (rst) begin
            operand_a <= 0;
            operand_b <= 0;
            opcode <= 0;
            input_valid <= 0;
        end else begin
            operand_a <= a;
            operand_b <= b;
            opcode <= Oper;
            input_valid <= in_valid;
        end
    end

    pw_alu #(.WIDTH(WIDTH)) alu (
        .a(operand_a), .b(operand_b), .Oper(opcode), .sum(alu_result)
    );

    genvar index;
    generate
        for (index=0; index<STAGES-1; index=index+1) begin: output_pipeline
            reg [WIDTH-1:0] data_reg;
            reg valid_reg;
            wire [WIDTH-1:0] next_data;
            wire next_valid;
            if (index==0) begin: first_stage
                assign next_data = alu_result;
                assign next_valid = input_valid;
            end else begin: following_stage
                assign next_data = stage_data[index-1];
                assign next_valid = stage_valid[index-1];
            end
            always @(posedge clk) begin
                if (rst) begin
                    data_reg <= 0;
                    valid_reg <= 0;
                end else begin
                    data_reg <= next_data;
                    valid_reg <= next_valid;
                end
            end
            assign stage_data[index] = data_reg;
            assign stage_valid[index] = valid_reg;
        end
    endgenerate
    assign result = stage_data[STAGES-2];
    assign out_valid = stage_valid[STAGES-2];
endmodule",
  "bottleneck": "The operand-register to first output-register path includes 32-bit arithmetic carry propagation followed by operation selection and synchronous-reset gating. The original describes three independent arithmetic expressions.",
  "rewrite": "Share addition and both subtraction directions in one conditional-complement adder. Use explicit four-bit carry-lookahead groups and a parallel prefix across groups, followed by local lookahead within each group. Select arithmetic and logical results with decoded masks. Preserve the entire sequential shell and its named state.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Expected improvement comes from bounded local carry depth and logarithmic inter-group carry propagation, while reducing arithmetic-result selection. No numerical WNS improvement is claimed without the specified mapping and STA run.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Adds operand-complement gates and explicit prefix wiring, but replaces three arithmetic datapaths with one. Register count is unchanged. Final area against the 10341.668480um2 cap, electrical compliance, and mapped timing require evaluation.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Preserves unsigned WIDTH-bit modulo arithmetic, all seven operations, zero for opcode 111, synchronous reset, unconditional data updates, valid propagation, and original STAGES-dependent latency. No state is retimed or re-encoded, no initialization is introduced, and no assumptions about invalid-cycle data or repeated resets are used. Supports positive WIDTH and the original STAGES=2 or STAGES=3 configurations."
}
